fato_historico: 1996: Saddam Hussein's troops seize Irbil after the Kurdish Masoud Barzani appealed for help to defeat his Kurdish rival PUK.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to navigate complex landscapes with grace. Much like history reveals shifting alliances in distant lands, you may find your own inner circle evolving today. It is a good time to release old power struggles and embrace peaceful resolution, allowing your empathetic heart to find clarity amidst the changing tides of your personal journey.
frase_do_dia: True strength lies in the gentle art of making peace with yourself.
significado_numero: Represents the intuition and the unfolding of mysterious inner paths.
conselho: Consider letting go of unnecessary conflicts to invite more serenity into your life.
